== Title ==
<span lang="ja">敵を過大評価しすぎだ</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-279o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：相手が戦闘を宣言した直後に使う。負けた側の戦闘ダメージを３倍にする。２：「我々にもまだ勝算はある」の結果を３倍にする。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「退避だと？勝利を目前にしてか？」</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' You Overrate the Enemy.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. Use immediately after your opponent initiates a battle. Triple the losing side's battle damage. 2. Triple the result of [[Don't Underestimate Our Chances]].

'''Lore:''' “Retreat? With victory in sight?”

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 4

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
